title: NextGen IMPORT INTO can leave persistent row/index corruption when ordinary DML overlaps physical ingest

payload.dedup_basis: the issue already requires NextGen IMPORT INTO to enter Import table mode specifically to block user writes and DDL during long imports
payload.new_evidence: two current-source real-CSE REDs prove the missing protection can make a failed job leave persistent record/index divergence and obscure a later committed application value
payload.counting: do not assign a found_bug ID or increment root count
payload.do_not_repeat: reuse these runs as severity evidence; reopen only for a distinct fence owner, timestamp domain, or irreversible consumer
